# Reptilians
They can ONLY eat fruits and meat, but can eat raw meat and drink blood without any ill effects. They prefer a somewhat higher temperature range than humans. They can drag objects with their tail, keeping both their hands free.
Their unarmed claw attacks deal Slash damage instead of Blunt.
They take [color=#ffa500]30% more Cold damage.[/color]
## Naming Standards
Reptilians name themselves after their personality traits, professions or interests. These names may be either - hyphenated phrases in their native language (Neeti-Abijoo, Veek-Gilm) or - three word phrases following a [bold]verb[/bold]s-The-[bold]noun[/bold] format (Cooks-The-Food, Bites-The-Bullet, Drinks-The-Water).
